initial_false_green.cli: A real CLI put --data with nested duplicate threshold.value returned success and wrote the last value, 0.9, to the ledger before the correction.
initial_false_green.ledger: A duplicate key placed before its original in an event can leave the parsed object and its recomputed digest unchanged under last-wins parsing.
initial_false_green.approval_registry: The external trusted-approver registry used last-wins JSON parsing for repeated keys, including nested approver labels.

corrected_contract: The shared CLI and ledger parser rejects duplicate object keys at any nesting depth, including keys equal after JSON Unicode-escape decoding.
CLI put --data and run --manifest reject ambiguous JSON before case mutation.
Ledger read and append reject an ambiguous stored event before accepting its parsed digest or rewriting the file.
The external trusted-approver registry rejects repeated keys before accepting a signed approval.
